# Discover Project

## Inputs

* `${input:idea}`: Required application idea, product goal, or user problem

## Requirements

Follow the project discovery steps from `Modern Web App Architect`. Delegate
specification work to `Modern Product Spec Architect`, create or update
`.specs/project.md` and `.specs/roadmap.md`, and ask at most three blocking
questions per round. Do not implement production code.
